predictions: Probes were flat, so split rare names may reach only 0.05-0.3; single-token names stay under 0.05. The test will probably fail.
short: first piece of split rare name
notes: Card: very large max (454) on first pieces of rare names (Vall, Ak, L, Am, Im, Cald, Kn) in varied contexts. Probe was flat: Akesson 0.028, Amador 0.009, Vallombreuse 0.009, Stollenwerk 0.008; single-token controls 0.001-0.007. The top contexts must carry something the probes missed.
